correctness.rationale: Invariant integral 2-paths decompose by endpoints into oriented triangles, differences of long squares, and backtrack differences; the regular theory adds all individual backtracks. Their 1-boundaries generate the comparison kernel. Incident-edge equalities and triangle fillings settle all relations; arc coefficient-sum maps on triangle-free components send each surviving generator to 2 and exclude any torsion. Naturality follows on chains. Independently enumerated binary chain matrices for 1103 finite graphs all agree; finite checks are not proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed contribution is the all-finite-symmetric-graph exact integral kernel, its necessary and sufficient triangle-free-component criterion, and complete graph-filtration transition maps. Chaplin 2022 and GLMY already prove the generating-set ingredients and isolated examples, which are not claimed as new. Targeted published-finding corpus and primary-literature comparisons found no exact dominating statement; the main residual risk is an unindexed corollary of Chaplin generators.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural comparison classification for an infinite, unrestricted graph family, with a sharp structural triangle-free criterion and complete behavior under merges and triangle births in filtrations. It answers exactly when changing a standard homology convention can or cannot alter degree-one integral topology. The result is not an arbitrary parameter slice or finite recomputation, and its scope and limits are explicit.
